items.title: When thinking of Jonathan Kuminga in a vacuum, it may not be that appealing to Wolves fans. But when comparing him to Julius Randle and realizing while there is a drop off, it’s not actually as steep as we might assume it is.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
When thinking of Jonathan Kuminga in a vacuum, it may not be that appealing to Wolves fans. But when comparing him to Julius Randle and realizing while there is a drop off, it’s not actually as steep as we might assume it is. 

Screenshot: Dunksandthrees.com

images.alt: Dunks & Threes EPM & Estimated Skills table comparing Julius Randle (MIN, F-C, age 31) and Jonathan Kuminga (ATL, F, age 23), dated Jun 13, 2026, with percentile ranks below each stat. Randle: 35.8 MPG (94), 25.6 USG (91), +0.7 OFF (82), +0.1 DEF (69), +0.7 EPM (79), 28.3 PTS (88), 58.0 TS% (68), 15.3 2PA (91), 53.1 2P% (41), 5.4 3PA (29), 33.4 3P% (39), 8.5 FTA (95), 78.2 FT% (56), 2.9 ORB (68), 6.7 DRB (63), 4.9 AST (64), 4.3 TOV (4), 1.3 STL (25), 0.3 BLK (8). Kuminga: 23.7 MPG (61), 22.3 USG (82), -1.4 OFF (45), +0.8 DEF (87), -0.5 EPM (66), 26.2 PTS (83), 56.6 TS% (53), 12.6 2PA (81), 54.8 2P% (58), 7.3 3PA (51), 32.7 3P% (28), 7.3 FTA (92), 71.0 FT% (21), 2.5 ORB (62), 7.5 DRB (74), 3.6 AST (43), 3.1 TOV (23), 1.4 STL (40), 0.7 BLK (48). Below, an Estimated Plus-Minus line chart by age from 19 to 31.5, with scatter points behind each trend line. Randle's green line starts near -2.8 at age 19, dips to about -3.0 around 21, then climbs steadily to a peak near +2.5 at age 26, oscillates between roughly +1.0 and +2.7 through his late twenties, and ends at +0.7 at age 31.5 (Gm 1014). Kuminga's blue line starts near -2.9 at 19, rises sharply to about +1.0 at 21.5, spikes again near +1.0 at 22, then falls to -0.5 at age 23.7 (Gm 463).
